role: The world's data/ folder cache of WorldSavedData objects by name (villages, scoreboard, map_N, structure start data), with idcounts.dat handing out unique ids such as map numbers.
scope_reason: World construction loads the village collection through it (World.java: mapStorage.loadData(VillageCollection.class, "villages")) and villages are on in world.conf; structure start data and the scoreboard also persist through it. Map id allocation (getUniqueDataId("map")) is only reached with maps, which world.conf switches off. The save-writing side is deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain; triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md). The read side is a real item (B2).

notes: No native file names MapStorage or its members. villagers.c (villager_update_ai_tick) notes the replay's village collection never exists because a whole-server snapshot has no villages.dat; serverreplay.c points the tick at an in-memory collection instead. Whether the missing load matters for any recording was not verified. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings). MapStorage's reachable WorldSavedData are the VillageCollection (villages.dat: the snapshot's villages.nbt, the collection as the oracle held it, serverreplay.c) and each MapGenStructureData (structures.json); idCounts and the map data are for maps, off in world.conf.
